essence: The seventh nyāsa consists of placing the letters from a to kṣa beginning with the śrī-seed.
The ninth nyāsa is the placement of the mothers beginning with the kāma-seed.
The tenth nyāsa places hrīṃ as śakti on the feet and āṃ as kīla in the navel.
The formula hrīṃ vīṃ tatpuruṣāya namas is placed on the two index fingers.
The formula hrūṃ vūṃ aghorāya namo should be placed on the middle fingers.
